create_base_filter: create a BaseFilter subclass that implements the abstract filter method to keep or drop documents
run_base_filter: run a BaseFilter on a DocumentsPipeline to filter documents by batch or individually
build_batch_filter: build a custom filter_batch method in a BaseFilter subclass for efficient batch document filtering
test_get_filter_result: test the get_filter_result helper function that extracts result and reason from filter output
review_base_filter_run: review the BaseFilter run method that processes documents, tracks stats, and writes excluded documents
